During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''civil war''' broke out on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Livien]]. Rebel factions, backed by the Republic, rebelled against the Imperial-backed [[House of Tion/Legends|royal family]], and the planet was thrown into chaos as a result.

==Behind the scenes==
The Livien civil war is mentioned in two separate and faction-specific Crew Skill missions in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Republic players can have their companions complete the Underworld Trading mission "Overthrowing the Tyrants," which says that the rebels oust the royal family, while Imperial players can have their companions do the Underworld Trading mission "Quashing the Rebels," which claims that the royal family crushed the rebels.
